resources.string: What\'s new (v46)
The two-part top menu, the add menu on an empty spot and the selection menu at the corner of the selected item.
Two-part top menu
Tools sit in two parts: stacked in portrait, side by side in landscape. When you switch mode (Draw, Add, Select…) both parts show that mode\'s tools.
Tap an empty spot to add
In Add mode, tapping an empty spot opens a vertical add menu right there: shape, text, formula, diagram… The item is added where you tapped.
Selection menu
When you select an item, a translucent menu appears at its corner: Move, Scale, Copy, Delete and Edit.
Scale and copy
Scale makes the selection bigger or smaller; Copy places a copy next to it. Here the sun shrinks and the birds multiply.
Edit
Edit opens actions for the item\'s type: edit shape, colour and fill, bring forward or send back, hide. Science shapes show their values here.
What\'s new (v46)
A Cornell page with Add panels, and physics and element shapes that redraw when you type values.
Add panels
Split the page into framed areas: columns, grids, square areas or the Cornell layout (key questions, notes, summary). Each area is its own item.
Title and questions
Write the title in the notes area and the questions you\'ll ask yourself in the left column. When reviewing, cover the notes and look only at the questions.
Shape drawn from a formula
Free-body diagram, pulleys, lever and element shapes come with their formulas: forces, arrow lengths and results are calculated from the values.
Type a value, the shape changes
Type a new value in the shape\'s formula field (e.g. F = 40, α = 30°) and the shape is redrawn; the corner formula and results update too.
Element shapes
The periodic table cell and the Bohr atom model are drawn for the element you type: symbol (Na), name (sodium) or atomic number (11). Here sodium turns into chlorine.
Formula and summary
Add a ready formula under the diagram and write the topic\'s summary in the bottom strip. The page is ready for review.
What\'s new (v46)
A real panel layout, ready locations and characters, balloons, effects; the cover and ready templates.
Panel layout
Pick a layout from Templates: panels resize together, the gutter is adjustable and drawings inside move with their panel.
Location background
Drop a ready location into a panel: the picture is cropped to the panel\'s shape and sits behind the panel border.
Characters
Choose an expression, pose or action from Characters, then size and place it in the panel. Premium characters show a lock.
Balloons
A caption sets the scene; speech, shout, thought and whisper balloons give the characters a voice. Point the tail at the speaker.
Speed lines and sound
Speed lines show motion and sound effects show sound. Keeping the lines behind the character makes the scene easier to read.
Cover and ready templates
A new comic starts with a cover page. When creating a canvas, pick a ready sample under Template (action, manga, webtoon, four-panel, dialogue) and carry on from it.
What\'s new (v46)
The two-part menu, rectangle selection and the eyedropper in the top menu.
Add panels, and science shapes that redraw when you type values.
Shapes
Pick a shape and drag: house, sun, star… Filled shapes quickly build the base of the picture.
Rectangle selection
Draw an area with rectangle selection in the top menu; everything inside is selected, then move or resize it.
Eyedropper
Tap a colour in the picture with the eyedropper; the brush takes that colour.
Paint brush
Move your finger with Paint! If you start inside a shape, the paint stays inside.
